observations: First-failure diagnosis from authenticated Woodpecker step logs, not CI status: #2240/1, #2241/1 and #2242/1 all failed on exactly one test, 'native compiler rejects Effect downgrade from KDP_INTENT to arbitrary LOCAL rule', whose assert.throws validator received DisV020Error DIS_KDP_RECEIPT_BINDING_UNSUPPORTED from qualifyDisV020Artifact's R16 receipt-binding guard instead of the expected DIS_LOCAL_NOT_QUALIFIED.
